- **Colour schemes.** Twelve schemes in Settings, all keeping the star chart:
  four game colours (Starmap, High Contrast, Dusk, Chart Room, a light paper
  chart for projectors) and eight operations-floor schemes (Clear Signal,
  Narrative, OODA, Resilience, Friction, Grey Zone, Ground Truth, Cognitive
  Domain) with faint nebula skies.
- **Easier-to-read text.** The default Starmap scheme lifts all grey text; the
  dimmest text is now 7.3:1 against the panels (was 3:1). Every scheme passes
  4.5:1 for all text, checked by the tests.
- Colour-safe mode and text size work with every scheme.

Same rules as 0.13: two-player codes work between 0.13, 0.13.1 and 0.13.2.

Full history: see What's new on the playtest page.
